turn.context: Playbook §4, KPIs: curated to the ones with real numbers, the rest marked new. Discharge §8.

text: Nine measures, not all sixteen. Five already have your starting number.
The other four are new. They get no number until the trial records one, so none is made up.
chat.pointer: Filter the windows, or flip to see what the trial will fill in. Pick one for how it is measured.
chat.invite: Next, we can see what happens after the two weeks.
chat.note: Measure what you already know first.
prompts: What happens after the two weeks?

blocks.title: Nine windows to watch
blocks.deck: Your starting numbers where you gave them. Blank windows for the new ones, filled by the trial.

blocks.condition: Goals are set on day 3 of the trial, from the ward’s own times.

measures.name: Hours from ready to home
measures.how: From the doctor’s go-ahead to the patient leaving the ward.

measures.name: Patients home by 10 AM
measures.how: Share of patients without insurance home by 10 AM. Insured patients by 1 PM.

measures.name: Decided on the evening round
measures.how: Share of discharges first marked on the evening round, not the same morning.

measures.name: Bed empty after leaving
measures.how: From the patient leaving to the bed ready for the next one.

measures.name: Time to finish the bill
measures.how: From the doctor’s signature to the final bill.

measures.name: Insurance approval time
measures.how: From the request to the insurer’s yes, evening and morning apart.

measures.name: Family told before leaving
measures.how: Share of patients whose family got diet, medicine and follow-up advice before leaving.

measures.name: Money won back
measures.how: Revenue from freed bed days, against the most it could be.

measures.name: Discharges a day
measures.how: Checked each month against the line for the Discharge Manager.
